features.desc: Plenty of apps capture notes. Chaerok is different after the capture — organizing and resurfacing are Chaerok's job, not yours.

s2.title: Chaerok writes it up

s3.title: It comes back to you

ontology.desc: Most note apps stop at putting things in. Chaerok brings your notes back — so today's capture becomes material for tomorrow's thinking.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Can I use it for free?
faq.a1: Core features — capture, organizing, search — are free forever on your device, no account needed. Full long-form understanding, image understanding, Chaerok's briefings and weekly report, and cross-device sync come with Chaerok Pro, and your first two weeks of Pro are free.
faq.a2: Notes are saved on your device first. Sign in and turn on Chaerok Pro cloud sync to back them up and continue on other devices. Bulk export to files like Markdown and CSV is coming gradually.
faq.q3: What happens to my notes if I cancel?
faq.a3: They all stay on your device. Only cloud sync stops — everything that runs on-device keeps working for free.
faq.q4: When can I use it on Android?
faq.a4: The full launch is in the works. You can start today through Google Play early access, and your notes carry over after launch.

cta.title: From here on, Chaerok remembers for you
cta.desc: Before it slips away — Chaerok. Signing up takes 30 seconds.

faq.q5: Do you support languages other than Korean?
faq.a5: Semantic analysis fully supports Korean and English today, with more languages coming gradually.
